title: How Lighthouse Keepers Ate, Washed & Slept on a Rock in the Sea
intro: Three men in a stone tower eleven miles out to sea, a round bedroom, no shower, and no toilet until 1964. Here's how Scotland's rock lighthouse keepers lived, and the mystery of the Flannan Isles.
asof_line: History from National Records of Scotland and a UK government pay report (c. 1971).
